title: CustomGames
description: A Paper plugin to create cool games like Minecraft, but lava rises every day
body:
# CustomGames
---
#### CustomGames is a Paper plugin which allows players to create a Minecraft challenge (At the moment, only one is aviable but other types are coming soon !), like : Minecraft, but lava rises every day.
#### It is useful for instance to streamers/youtubers that want to make a challenge video without having to struggle with datapacks or anything else.
---
## How to use ?
Simply download the plugin (ideal and tested version : 1.21.4) and place it in your `plugins` folder !
Then, boot up your server, check the `plugins/CustomGames/config.yml` file and edit it with your preferences. Once it's done, run /cg reload to apply.
### To play a game :
- Run /cg menu or /cg gui
- Click the game you want to play to
- Choose your parameters like hardcore mode, lava speed and other stuff
- Click the green button
- Wait until world is generated
- You will be teleported to the custom world and game will start !
---
### How to invite friends ?
- Launch your game
- Than make sure your friend is connected to the same server
- Run /cg invite <name>
- Your friend will recieve an invite. Tell him to accept
- Done ! You can play together!
